$comment: names.json: the names register of the scrapyard game (game id scrap-yard; ruling 14 in the lead's RULING.md; yard-design.md section 2 lists the names). Every invented proper noun is searched here BEFORE art or text is built on it. THIS IS AN ENGINEER'S CHECK, RECORDED AS SUCH: IT IS NOT LEGAL CLEARANCE. No trademark register (USPTO, EUIPO, UKIPO, WIPO Global Brand Database, CNIPA) was searched; the owner's own trade-mark search of at least the title is still required before release (yard-design.md 7.7, yard-policy.md 2). Filled on 2026-11-25 by the step labelled 'names'. Four checks per name: (a) a real company, brand or product of that name or one letter or one sound away, above all in metals, recycling, mining, electronics, cars, shipping and finance (UK Companies House search, web search, Bing exact-word results, the stores' publisher names); (b) a real exchange, index, port, town or region (web search, gazetteers met in results); (c) an app or game of that name on the stores (App Store search API, country US, 50 results; Google Play web search, US); (d) a name already used in this developer's four games, exact or one letter or one Soundex step away (grep of games/{pizza-empire,space-miner,night-market,high-office}/game.json, src/ui/{haul,merge,decree}/strings.ts, scripts/content/office/*.json and the three store files; plus scripts/content/build-space.py by hand for Orbit Haulers' sector and buyer names). Threshold used: an exact name of any real firm, product, app or game, or a word one letter or one sound from a real firm in the listed trades, a real town or region, or a name in the four games, fails; a common surname or given name shared only with unrelated small firms (builders, cafes) passes and is recorded. Verdicts: 'clear', 'changed' (with 'replacedBy'), 'new (replacement)' (with 'replaces'; it passed the same four checks). The specification is NOT edited here: the lead designer applies this register. Web queries contained only the candidate names and generic trade words. Method and scripts: notes/names.md in the shared notes folder.
